generator: ChatGPT image generation (OpenAI GPT image model)
rules: See ASSET_PIPELINE.md. Status `needs-generation` = no generated file in the repo yet; the app keeps showing the authored SVG study art listed in `current`. Status `approved` = reviewed, ingested with scripts/ingest-art.mjs and served by the app.

worlds.title: HOME — The Arena Concourse
worlds.ui: HOME world: full-bleed background layer `.home-art` behind the CAW HELPER title (title sits on the left 45% of the frame).
worlds.what: The empty backstage tunnel of a historic wrestling arena moments before doors open.
worlds.why: Establishes the CAW Helper universe in one image: wrestling history, craft and anticipation.
worlds.communicates: You are about to walk out and build a character. Grand, theatrical, physical.
worlds.differs: The only world that shows the ring/arena itself; every other world is a workroom.
worlds.subject: A long, high-ceilinged entrance tunnel of an old municipal wrestling arena, looking out toward a single empty ring bathed in a pale spotlight at the far end. On a steamer trunk in the right foreground rests one folded original wrestling mask (crimson leather with gold trim, no symbols) beside taped boots and a coiled rope.
worlds.composition: Camera low (knee height) in the tunnel, 28mm lens, one-point perspective. Foreground right: trunk with folded mask and boots, sharp. Middle ground: tunnel walls of painted brick with faded, wordless poster frames and cable runs. Background: the lit ring and dark tiered seating. Keep the left 45% of the frame calm and dark for the UI title.
worlds.construction: Worn painted brick, scuffed concrete floor with taped markings, riveted steel tunnel beams, canvas ring apron, hemp-wrapped ropes, scratched steamer trunk with brass corners.
worlds.lighting: Key: cold white spotlight on the ring far away producing volumetric beams. Fill: weak tungsten work lamps along the tunnel. Rim: warm amber kicker on the trunk and mask. Deep shadows on the left.
worlds.color: Near-black and smoked brown base, warm bone and restrained gold accents, a single muted red note on the mask. No neon.
worlds.atmosphere: Light haze and floating dust in the beams; slight depth fog toward the ring.

worlds.title: CREATE — The Character Drafting Table
worlds.ui: CREATE world: background layer behind the light "BUILD THE WHOLE THING" layout; the world uses a warm paper palette, so this image is shown light and slightly desaturated.
worlds.what: A top-down view of a character designer's drafting table mid-project.
worlds.why: CREATE connects body, attire, moves and entrance into one project; a planning table shows all pieces together.
worlds.communicates: Planning, drafting and assembling an entire wrestler, not just one item.
worlds.differs: Only light, overhead, paper-dominant image in the set; shot from directly above.
worlds.subject: Directly overhead view of a large oak drafting table covered with loose sheets of heavy cream paper bearing pencil figure sketches of an original wrestler (front/back turnaround poses), fabric swatches pinned with brass pins, a small leather boot sample, a measuring tape, graphite pencils, a pencil sharpener, and a folded original mask swatch. Absolutely no readable text, no logos.
worlds.composition: Flat lay, camera perpendicular to the table. Objects arranged in a loose asymmetric cluster along the right and bottom edges; the upper-left 50% stays mostly clean cream paper for UI copy.
worlds.construction: Oak with visible grain, toothy cream paper with soft graphite lines and smudges, satin and lycra swatches, brass pins, cloth measuring tape, a cut leather boot vamp with visible stitching.
worlds.lighting: Large soft window key from the upper left, gentle fill, soft contact shadows under every object; no harsh specular.
worlds.color: Warm paper (#dcd6ca range), oak brown, graphite grey, one muted red and one gold swatch.
worlds.atmosphere: Calm, tactile, studio quiet; very fine paper texture.

worlds.title: MASK ARCHIVE — The Mask Wall
worlds.ui: MASK MAKER world (mask wall): full-bleed `.mask-bg` layer behind the mask grid and inspector; darkened to ~68% brightness under UI.
worlds.what: A vast, old archive hall where hundreds of original wrestling masks hang on display.
worlds.why: Flagship world. The archive is the place you study masks before making one.
worlds.communicates: Scale, history and reverence for the craft; masks as real objects, not icons.
worlds.differs: The only world with many masks at multiple depths; architectural and museum-like.
worlds.subject: A cavernous archive hall with tall aged plaster walls lined floor to ceiling with dark wooden display shelving and wall-mounted head forms, each holding a different original wrestling mask (varied silhouettes: horned, crested, smooth, winged; leather, satin, metallic). Rolling library ladders, glass vitrines on wooden plinths in the middle ground, brass inventory tags hanging from string (tags blank).
worlds.composition: Camera at standing eye height, 35mm, two-point perspective looking down the hall. Foreground: a vitrine edge and one mask on a head form, slightly out of focus at frame right. Middle ground: rows of shelving receding. Background: an arched end wall dissolving into haze. Masks at clearly different distances.
worlds.construction: Aged lime plaster with water stains, dark stained walnut shelving, brass rails and tag hooks, worn parquet floor, glass vitrines with bevelled edges, linen-covered head forms.
worlds.lighting: Key: high clerestory windows casting slanted shafts. Fill: low warm picture lights over shelving. Rim: thin gold edge light on foreground mask. Strong falloff into dark corners.
worlds.color: Deep umber, black, aged ivory plaster, restrained gold; masks provide scattered muted reds, blues and silvers.
worlds.atmosphere: Visible dust motes in light shafts, soft fog toward the back wall.

worlds.title: MASK MAKER — The Mask Construction Bench
worlds.ui: MASK BUILDER world: `.builder-backdrop` layer behind the builder controls and live preview stage (darkened to ~42%).
worlds.what: The workbench where masks are physically patterned, cut and stitched.
worlds.why: The builder is about construction choices; the backdrop should show how masks are actually made.
worlds.communicates: Craft and construction: patterns, panels, stitching, materials.
worlds.differs: Archive = finished masks on display; this = unfinished masks in pieces on a bench.
worlds.subject: A heavy wooden mask-maker's workbench beneath a pegboard wall. A canvas-covered head form in the centre wears a half-finished original mask (one panel pinned, unstitched). Around it: paper pattern pieces for mask panels, cut leather and stretch-satin panels, an industrial sewing machine at frame left, spools of heavy thread, an awl, leather shears, grommet setter, lace, eyelets in a tin.
worlds.composition: Camera at bench height, 3/4 angle, 40mm. Foreground: scattered eyelets and thread, shallow focus. Middle ground: head form and panels (focal). Background: pegboard with hanging tools and pattern templates. Keep the right-centre area (where the live preview renders) relatively dark and uncluttered.
worlds.construction: Scarred maple bench, perforated pegboard, steel tools with worn handles, cut leather edges showing thickness, satin with sheen, waxed thread, brass eyelets.
worlds.lighting: Key: a single articulated task lamp above the head form (warm). Fill: very low cool ambient. Rim: lamp spill on tool edges. Deep shadow in the corners.
worlds.color: Dark wood brown, black, warm lamp gold, a muted red leather panel, steel grey.
worlds.atmosphere: Faint thread lint and dust in the lamp cone; intimate, focused.

worlds.title: BODY LAB — The Physique Laboratory
worlds.ui: BODY world: `.generic-art` layer of the BODY workshop (dimmed to ~36% under the three study cards).
worlds.what: An athletic anatomy and proportion laboratory.
worlds.why: BODY is about proportion, stance and physical presence before attire.
worlds.communicates: Measurement, structure, honest study of the human form.
worlds.differs: Clinical and clean; the only cool-lit world. No masks or gear.
worlds.subject: A clean, high-ceilinged physique study room. Centre: a full-size articulated neutral grey mannequin (featureless head, athletic heavyweight wrestler build) standing on a turntable platform in front of a large measurement grid wall. Around it: a vintage height rod, a wall-mounted calliper, a balance scale, plaster anatomy casts (shoulder, forearm, torso) on shelves, posture reference silhouettes on frosted glass panels (no text).
worlds.composition: Camera at chest height, frontal-left 3/4, 35mm. Foreground: edge of an equipment cart with callipers and tape, softly blurred. Middle ground: mannequin on turntable (focal, right of centre). Background: grid wall and shelves of casts.
worlds.construction: Matte grey mannequin with visible joint segments, painted steel grid wall, white plaster casts, chrome measurement tools, terrazzo floor, frosted glass.
worlds.lighting: Controlled studio lighting: large overhead softbox key, cool fill from the left, crisp white rim on the mannequin silhouette. Clean shadows.
worlds.color: Cool greys and off-white, steel blue shadows, a single thin gold measurement line accent.
worlds.atmosphere: Very slight clean haze; precise, quiet.

worlds.title: LEGS / ATTIRE WORKSHOP — The Gear Tailor
worlds.ui: ATTIRE world: `.generic-art` layer of the ATTIRE workshop.
worlds.what: A wrestling-gear tailor's workroom focused on tights, trunks and kneepads.
worlds.why: ATTIRE is about lower-body gear layers and material coordination.
worlds.communicates: Garments as built objects: patterns, fabrics, padding.
worlds.differs: Fabric-dominant; hanging garments and a dress form, unlike the boot bench or mask bench.
worlds.subject: A tailor's workroom: a lower-body dress form wearing original long wrestling tights with contrasting side panels and quilted kneepads; a rolling garment rail holding trunks and tights in several fabrics; a cutting table with chalk-marked stretch fabric, rotary cutter, pattern weights; bolts of lycra, metallic spandex and velvet on a wall rack.
worlds.composition: Camera at hip height, 35mm, slight 3/4. Foreground: cutting table edge with chalk and pins. Middle ground: dress form (focal, centre-right). Background: fabric bolt wall and garment rail receding.
worlds.construction: Stretch lycra with sheen, metallic spandex, velvet nap, quilted vinyl kneepads with visible stitch lines, painted wood rack, steel garment rail.
worlds.lighting: Key: warm overhead pendant over the cutting table. Fill: soft window light from the right. Rim: sheen highlights along the tights panels.
worlds.color: Black and charcoal base, deep oxblood and teal fabrics, cream chalk, small gold accents.
worlds.atmosphere: Light fabric dust; lived-in workshop warmth.

worlds.title: SHOE WORKSHOP — The Boot Maker
worlds.ui: SHOES world: `.generic-art` layer of the SHOES workshop.
worlds.why: Boots are their own craft: lasts, soles, lacing, padding.
worlds.communicates: Leather, stitching, soles and tools, real footwear construction.
worlds.differs: Leather and tool dominant, lowest and closest camera of the set.
worlds.subject: A cobbler's bench holding an unfinished tall original wrestling boot on a wooden last (knee-high, lace-up front, padded collar, contrasting toe cap). Around it: cut leather vamp and quarter pieces, a stack of rubber soles, a cast-iron last stand, hammers, awls, edge bevelers, a pot of contact cement, waxed laces, a tray of brass eyelets, a finished pair of boots on a shelf behind.
worlds.composition: Camera low at bench height, close, 50mm. Foreground: tools and eyelets, shallow focus. Middle ground: boot on last (focal, left-centre). Background: shelves of lasts and finished boots fading into shadow.
worlds.construction: Full-grain leather showing pores and cut edges, heavy saddle stitching, black gum rubber soles with tread, beech lasts, cast iron, waxed thread.
worlds.lighting: Key: warm low-angle lamp raking across the leather to show texture. Fill: very low. Rim: cool back light outlining the boot shaft.
worlds.color: Dark leather browns and black, oxblood, brass, bone thread.
worlds.atmosphere: Fine leather dust in the light; dense, crafted, close.

worlds.title: ACCESSORIES — The Dressing Room
worlds.ui: ACCESSORIES world: `.generic-art` layer of the ACCESSORIES workshop.
worlds.what: A wrestler's backstage dressing room before a show.
worlds.why: Accessories finish a character: gloves, belts, jewellery, glasses, robes, props.
worlds.communicates: Personal identity objects laid out ready to wear.
worlds.differs: The only world with mirrors and bulb lighting; personal and theatrical.
worlds.subject: A backstage dressing room: a long counter beneath a row of bulb-framed mirrors. On the counter: fingerless leather gloves, wrist tape rolls, sunglasses, a heavy chain, rings, an open jewellery case. A generic championship-style belt with an original, wordless, abstract metal plate hangs on a hook. An original sequinned entrance robe on a rail, metal lockers, a folding chair with a towel.
worlds.composition: Camera at seated eye height, 3/4 down the counter, 35mm. Foreground: gloves and tape sharp. Middle ground: mirrors reflecting the room (no people in reflections). Background: robe rail and lockers.
worlds.construction: Glossy mirror glass with slight desilvering at the edges, bulb sockets, chrome and brass, worn leather gloves, sequins, painted steel lockers, linoleum floor.
worlds.lighting: Key: warm vanity bulbs. Fill: cool fluorescent spill from an open door. Rim: specular glints on chain and belt plate.
worlds.color: Warm amber, black, gold and chrome, one deep purple robe accent.
worlds.atmosphere: Slight haze and a lived-in, pre-show tension.

worlds.title: EXPLORE — The Collection Gallery
worlds.ui: EXPLORE world: `.generic-art` layer behind ORIGINALS / COLLECTIONS / CREATOR NOTES.
worlds.what: A curated gallery of complete character looks.
worlds.why: EXPLORE is discovery across categories, not only masks.
worlds.communicates: Breadth and curation: many finished original characters to browse.
worlds.differs: Shows whole-character outfits on mannequins in a gallery, not single objects.
worlds.subject: A long gallery corridor with polished dark floors and a row of illuminated display alcoves, each holding a faceless mannequin dressed in a different complete original wrestler look (masked luchador style, brawler in jacket and jeans, high-flyer in long tights, monster-heel in coat). Wordless brass plaques below each alcove.
worlds.composition: Camera at standing height, looking down the corridor, 24mm, strong depth. Foreground: first alcove at frame right, close. Middle ground: alcoves recede left-to-right. Background: corridor end in deep shadow.
worlds.construction: Polished black terrazzo, dark wood alcove frames, brass plaques and rails, mixed garment materials on mannequins.
worlds.lighting: Each alcove lit from above by a warm spot, pools of light in a dark corridor; reflections on the floor.
worlds.color: Black and walnut with warm gold pools; outfits supply varied but muted colours.
worlds.atmosphere: Light haze in each spot cone; museum hush.

worlds.title: LEARN — The Design Classroom
worlds.ui: LEARN world: `.generic-art` layer behind SILHOUETTE / MATERIAL / COMPOSITION lessons.
worlds.what: A wrestling-design classroom with study materials on display.
worlds.why: LEARN teaches silhouette, material and composition through exercises.
worlds.communicates: Teaching and study: structured, hands-on, approachable.
worlds.differs: Classroom with silhouette cut-outs and material swatch boards, not a workshop or gallery.
worlds.subject: A daylit classroom with a large slate chalkboard covered in chalk sketches of mask silhouettes and proportion diagrams (no words), a row of black cardboard silhouette cut-outs of wrestler shapes pinned on a cork wall, framed material swatch boards (leather, satin, rubber, metal mesh) and wooden student tables with sketchbooks and colour chips.
worlds.composition: Camera from the back of the room at seated height, 35mm. Foreground: a table edge with an open sketchbook and colour chips. Middle ground: chalkboard (focal). Background: cork wall and window light.
worlds.construction: Slate with chalk dust, cork board, cardboard cut-outs, framed swatches, scuffed wooden tables, paper.
worlds.lighting: Key: tall side windows (soft daylight from the left). Fill: warm ceiling globe lights. Gentle rim on chalkboard frame.
worlds.color: Slate black, chalk white, warm wood, muted swatch colours, a gold frame accent.
worlds.atmosphere: Chalk dust in the window light; calm.

worlds.title: STUDY MODE — The Inspection Room
worlds.ui: STUDY MODE: background of the mask inspection modal `.modal-visual` behind the selected mask (the mask image sits centred on top, so the centre must be empty).
worlds.what: A close-up conservation/inspection station where a single object is examined.
worlds.why: Study mode isolates one mask to read its construction.
worlds.communicates: Focus, scrutiny, close reading of an object.
worlds.differs: Intentionally empty centre: the stage for one object, not an environment to browse.
worlds.subject: A conservation inspection table seen at a low angle: black felt table surface, an empty central area, an articulated magnifier lamp at the left edge, a measuring scale ruler, white cotton conservator gloves, a small brush, a loupe, a grey card at the right edge, a dark curtain behind.
worlds.composition: Camera at table height, 50mm, symmetrical. Foreground: felt surface edge. Middle ground: completely empty centre (the UI places the mask here). Tools only at far left and right edges. Background: dark velvet curtain with soft falloff.
worlds.construction: Black felt with fibres visible, brushed aluminium lamp arm, glass lens, steel ruler, white cotton gloves, velvet.
worlds.lighting: Key: a single focused overhead pool on the empty centre. Faint warm fill from the magnifier lamp. Everything else falls off to near black.
worlds.color: Black and charcoal, a soft neutral pool of light, small warm brass and steel accents.
worlds.atmosphere: Very faint dust in the light pool; silent and focused.

worlds.title: LIBRARY — The Personal Vault
worlds.ui: LIBRARY world: background layer behind "YOUR WORLD" and the saved project versions list.
worlds.what: A private storage vault for the user's own saved designs.
worlds.why: LIBRARY holds the user's versions; it should feel like personal archived work.
worlds.differs: Storage drawers and garment boxes, private and compact rather than a public archive.
worlds.subject: A compact private vault room: walls of flat-file steel drawers and labelled-but-wordless archival garment boxes, one drawer pulled open showing tissue-wrapped folded mask and gear pieces, a reading table with a closed leather portfolio and a lamp, a heavy vault door ajar at frame left.
worlds.composition: Camera at standing height, 35mm, slight 3/4. Foreground: open drawer with tissue-wrapped pieces (right). Middle ground: reading table. Background: drawer walls. Keep the left 50% darker for the UI list.
worlds.construction: Powder-coated steel drawers with brass label holders (empty), acid-free grey boxes, tissue paper, leather portfolio, thick steel vault door with bolt work.
worlds.lighting: Key: warm reading lamp. Fill: dim cool overhead. Rim: highlight along drawer edges.
worlds.color: Graphite, warm brass, archival grey, muted red accent on one wrapped piece.
worlds.atmosphere: Still air, slight haze, safe and private.

masks.name: Ember Dragon
masks.concept: A dragon-fire full-head mask built like armour from overlapping leather scales that rise into a swept-back crest.
masks.silhouette: Angular full hood; a central ridge of three tall overlapping leather fins runs from forehead to crown and sweeps backward; cheek panels flare slightly into jaw points.
masks.construction: Black stretch base hood; layered crimson leather scale panels stitched in rows from brow to cheeks; gold metallic vinyl trim piping along every scale edge; rear black lacing with brass eyelets.
masks.eyes: Sharp angular eye openings trimmed in gold piping, pointed outer corners sweeping upward toward the temples.
masks.mouth: Closed: the mouth area is covered by a jaw panel of small crimson scales.
masks.surface: Slightly aged leather with burnished highlights on scale tips, raised stitching, metallic trim catching light.
masks.personality: Aggressive, regal, a heavyweight champion's armour.

views.label: FRONT
views.camera: Camera dead-on at eye level, the mask facing the lens squarely; both eye openings equal; centred, the whole head form in frame with ~12% margin on every side.

views.label: 3/4 FRONT
views.camera: Camera rotated 40 degrees to the mask's left, at eye level; the near cheek panel foreshortens, the far eye opening narrows, the nose bridge breaks the far contour.

views.label: SIDE
views.camera: True 90-degree profile facing frame left, at eye level; shows brow projection, nose/mouth relief depth, the ear opening (if any) and where the face panel meets the crown and back panels.

views.label: 3/4 BACK
views.camera: Camera 135 degrees around, slightly behind the mask's right ear; reveals the crown seam, the start of the rear lacing channel and how the side panels wrap.

views.label: BACK
views.camera: Camera directly behind at eye level; full rear lacing (eyelets, laces, tongue/gusset), the back-of-head panel layout and the neck edge finishing.

masks.name: Frost Phoenix
masks.concept: A phoenix mask rendered in cold materials: white satin wings frozen into the brow.
masks.silhouette: Tapered hood with two wide feathered wing shapes extending from the temples back over the ears, tips slightly beyond the head outline.
masks.construction: White satin base; ice-blue leather feather panels appliquéd in layers on the brow and wings; silver metallic edge piping; tapered chin; white lacing at the back.
masks.eyes: Winged eye openings with long silver-trimmed tails that flow into the wing feathers.
masks.mouth: Closed: smooth white satin over the mouth with a subtle silver centre seam.
masks.surface: Satin sheen with soft blue reflected light, crisp feather edges, slightly frosted metallic trim.

masks.name: Jungle Spirit
masks.concept: A forest-spirit mask in embossed suede with organic leaf-vein panels.
masks.silhouette: Rounded organic hood, broad at the cheeks, with three short leaf-shaped tabs at the top of the crown.
masks.construction: Deep green suede base; embossed leaf-vein patterning; black leather leaf panels at the cheeks with gold-thread veining embroidery; open mouth with a stitched suede rim; side lacing behind the ears.
masks.eyes: Wide, slightly rounded eye openings framed by overlapping black leaf panels.
masks.mouth: Open oval mouth with a reinforced, hand-stitched suede rim.
masks.surface: Matte suede nap with directional texture, embossing catching raking light, gold thread glints.
masks.personality: Wild, earthy, a striker connected to nature.

masks.mouth: Closed: ivory panel with a stitched horizontal seam.
masks.surface: Polished leather sheen, metallic rays with slight wear at the tips, visible thread.

masks.construction: Matte black rubberised panels; a violet-tinted fine mesh panel over the lower face; thin silver seams dividing the face into vertical strips; rear zipper with a covered placket instead of lacing.

masks.mouth: Closed: covered by the violet mesh panel.

masks.name: Ocean King
masks.concept: A regal sea-monarch mask whose panels flow like waves.
masks.silhouette: Flowing hood with a low three-point crown at the forehead and wave-shaped panels sweeping back over the ears.
masks.construction: Royal blue satin base; white leather wave appliqués curving from the eyes back to the ears; gold metallic crown panel with stitched edge; gold piping on the waves; white lacing.
masks.eyes: Sharp, slightly elongated eye openings trimmed in white leather.
masks.mouth: Closed: blue satin mouth panel with a gold piped chin line.
masks.surface: Satin sheen with flowing highlights, matte white leather, polished metallic crown.
masks.personality: Noble, commanding, a champion from the coast.

masks.name: Shadow Fox
masks.concept: A trickster fox mask influenced by theatrical fox masks but built as a wrestling hood.

masks.eyes: Narrow slit eyes angled upward, backed with black mesh.
masks.mouth: Closed: white leather muzzle panel with a fine red stitched centre line.
masks.surface: Smooth white leather with soft sheen, velvety suede ears, crisp red edges.

masks.mouth: Closed: segmented dark green leather jaw guard.
masks.surface: Brushed metal with directional scratches and subtle edge wear, oiled leather, rivets with highlights.
